name: Tonewheel
description: Tonewheel organ: 91 gear-tuned wheels with foldback, nine drawbars on each of two manuals plus pedals, contact key click, single-triggered harmonic percussion, scanner vibrato and chorus, a tube preamp and a rotating speaker whose horn and drum speed up and brake at their own rates.

parameters.name: Topology
parameters.description: Engine option: which instrument this core runs. Fixed per plugin by the manifest default and hidden.

parameters.name: Manual Mode
parameters.description: Channels: upper on MIDI ch 1 (and ch 4..16), lower ch 2, pedals ch 3. Split: one keyboard, keys below Split Point play the lower manual. Upper: every channel plays the upper manual.

parameters.name: Split Point
parameters.description: Lowest MIDI note of the upper manual in Split mode.

parameters.name: Pedal Split
parameters.description: Split mode: keys below this note play the pedals (monophonic, lowest note wins). C4 = MIDI 60.

parameters.name: Tuning
parameters.description: Gear: 20 rev/s x teeth x gear ratio (the generator's own small errors). Equal: 12-TET.

parameters.name: Complex Wheels
parameters.description: Wheels 1..12 carry odd harmonics (near square), as the low wheels do.

parameters.name: Leakage
parameters.description: Every wheel faintly present while any key is held.

parameters.name: Crosstalk
parameters.description: Same-shaft wheel four octaves away and neighbouring wheels added to every keyed wheel.

parameters.name: Wheel Age
parameters.description: Random per-wheel level spread, 0 to 3 dB (seeded).

parameters.name: Key Click
parameters.description: Contact stagger and bounce depth on key down; 0 = clickless.

parameters.name: Release Click
parameters.description: Same on key up.

parameters.name: Pedal Sustain
parameters.description: Release time of the pedals (later consoles); 0 = B3 behaviour.

parameters.name: Percussion
parameters.description: Upper manual only. Steals the 1' drawbar.

parameters.name: Perc Harmonic
parameters.description: Second = 4' wheel, Third = 2 2/3' wheel of each keyed note.

parameters.name: Perc Volume
parameters.description: Normal: full percussion and the upper drawbars drop 4.4 dB. Soft: percussion 6 dB lower, drawbars unchanged.

parameters.name: Fast Decay Time
parameters.description: Time to -60 dB in Fast.

parameters.name: Slow Decay Time
parameters.description: Time to -60 dB in Slow.

parameters.name: Vibrato
parameters.description: Scanner vibrato depth (V) or vibrato mixed with dry (C, chorus).

parameters.name: Chorus Mix
parameters.description: Dry share in the C modes.

parameters.name: Expression
parameters.description: Swell pedal; MIDI CC 11 scales it further.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Tube preamp and speaker amp overdrive.

parameters.name: Leslie
parameters.description: Off: the dry preamp signal on both channels.

parameters.name: Rotor Speed
parameters.description: Target speed; the rotors accelerate and brake with inertia. Mod wheel above half = Fast.

parameters.name: Cabinet
parameters.description: Early reflections inside the cabinet.

parameters.name: Horn AM
parameters.description: Horn directivity depth.

parameters.name: Voices
parameters.description: Partials topology: voices, 64 partials each.

parameters.name: Partial Phase
parameters.description: Reset: every partial starts at sine phase 0 (identical attacks). Free: phases run on from the last note. Random: seeded random phases per note (smooth crest factor).

parameters.name: A 1
parameters.description: Level of partial n in spectrum A; -96 dB = off.

parameters.name: B 1
parameters.description: Level of partial n in spectrum B; -96 dB = off.

parameters.name: Morph
parameters.description: 0 = spectrum A, 1 = spectrum B, interpolated in dB per partial.

parameters.name: Morph Env
parameters.description: Morph envelope amount.

parameters.name: Morph LFO
parameters.description: LFO amount on the morph (unipolar, upward).

parameters.name: Morph Velocity
parameters.description: Velocity moves the morph start.

parameters.name: Tilt
parameters.description: Added per octave of partial number.

parameters.name: Odd/Even
parameters.description: -1 odd partials only, +1 even only (the fundamental is kept).

parameters.name: Stretch
parameters.description: Stiffness B of the Stretch ratio set: f_n = n f0 sqrt(1 + B n^2).

parameters.name: Ratio Set
parameters.description: Harmonic n f0; Stretch uses Stretch; Bell and Bar use fixed mode tables for the first partials.

parameters.name: Detune Spread
parameters.description: Seeded random detune per partial.

parameters.name: Group Map
parameters.description: Which of the four envelopes each partial follows.

parameters.name: Decay Tilt
parameters.description: Within a group, decay and release times scale by (n / first partial of the group)^-tilt.

parameters.name: Velocity
parameters.description: Amplitude velocity.

parameters.name: Velocity Bright
parameters.description: Soft notes lower the upper groups more than group 1.

parameters.name: Formant
parameters.description: Vowel formant curve fixed in Hz.

parameters.name: Vowel
parameters.description: Continuous A, E, I, O, U.

parameters.name: Formant Depth
parameters.description: Attenuation between the formant peaks.

parameters.name: Formant Env
parameters.description: Morph envelope moves the formant centres.

parameters.name: Vowel Env
parameters.description: Morph envelope moves the vowel.

parameters.name: Vowel LFO
parameters.description: LFO moves the vowel.

parameters.name: Peak
parameters.description: Gaussian bump at the cutoff.

parameters.name: Filter Env
parameters.description: Morph envelope, +-6 octaves.

parameters.name: Filter Key
parameters.description: Cutoff follows the note (1 = fixed in partial number), centred on C4.

parameters.name: Wheel Vibrato
parameters.description: Mod wheel adds this much LFO pitch depth.

parameters.name: Wheel Morph
parameters.description: Mod wheel moves the morph.

parameters.name: Wheel Formant
parameters.description: Mod wheel shifts the formants.

parameters.name: Partial Pan
parameters.description: Odd partials to the left, even to the right.
